name: Payment Transaction 176
definition: Provides reference and status information on the original transactions, included in the original instruction, to which the cancellation request message applies.

CancellationIdentification.name: Cancellation Identification
CancellationIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the assigner, to unambiguously identify a cancellation request.||Usage: The cancellation request identification can be used for reconciliation or to link tasks relating to the cancellation request.

Case.name: Case
Case.definition: Set of elements to uniquely and unambiguously identify an exception or an investigation workflow.

OriginalInstructionIdentification.name: Original Instruction Identification
OriginalInstructionIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original instructing party for the original instructed party, to unambiguously identify the original instruction.

OriginalEndToEndIdentification.name: Original End To End Identification
OriginalEndToEndIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original initiating party, to unambiguously identify the original transaction.

OriginalUETR.name: Original UETR
OriginalUETR.definition: Universally unique identifier to provide an end-to-end reference of a payment transaction.

OriginalInstructedAmount.name: Original Instructed Amount
OriginalInstructedAmount.definition: Amount of money, as provided in the original transaction, to be moved between the debtor and the creditor, before deduction of charges, expressed in the currency, as ordered by the original initiating party.||Usage: This amount has to be transported unchanged through the transaction chain.

OriginalRequestedExecutionDate.name: Original Requested Execution Date
OriginalRequestedExecutionDate.definition: Date at which the initiating party originally requested the clearing agent to process the payment.

OriginalRequestedCollectionDate.name: Original Requested Collection Date
OriginalRequestedCollectionDate.definition: Date at which the creditor originally requested the collection of the amount of money from the debtor.

CancellationReasonInformation.name: Cancellation Reason Information
CancellationReasonInformation.definition: Provides detailed information on the cancellation reason.

OriginalTransactionReference.name: Original Transaction Reference
OriginalTransactionReference.definition: Key elements used to identify the original transaction that is being referred to.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
